_comment: One contradiction that predates this check (bean `kpcl`, issue #956): `5a3l` (DEPLOYMENT) is `completed` while 12 of its children are open. Whether those twelve are unfinished deployment work or belong under another epic is a judgement about `5a3l`, and re-parenting or re-opening somebody's epic belongs to its owner — so the checker's author records it rather than repairs it. THIS FILE MAY ONLY SHRINK: an entry nothing matches is reported stale and fails, so a repair cannot leave a licence behind.
_shape: Same as bean-parents-baseline.json. Key is `<rule>:<bean-id>` — stable across a title edit, because a title is prose and an id is not.
